lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. person.qbi is the sum over the person's Schedule C entries of sc.qbi, which is Form 8995 line 1 column (c) for that business (person.yaml, cited to i8995 pp. 2, 4); line 2 adds them over the persons on the return, which is lines 1i to 1v column (c) with one row per Schedule C, and more than five businesses are included in the line 2 total as i8995 says ('include the income and loss from those trade(s) or business(es) in the total for line 2'). Other trades or businesses are refused through qbi.unsupported.

Ruling: scope; i8995 p. 4, Line 3: "Include here the qualified portion of trade or business (loss) carryforward allowed in calculating taxable income in the current year"; p. 3: "When losses or deductions previously suspended by other Code provisions are allowed in calculating taxable income, the qualified portion ... is treated as a qualified net loss carryforward from a separate trade or business ... See Line 3." Previously suspended losses are refused: qbi.suspended ("losses or deductions of a trade or business that were suspended in an earlier year by another provision (such as the at-risk or passive activity limits) and are allowed in calculating taxable income this year", asked with a Schedule C) is a limb of qbi.unsupported, which refuses qbi.eligible, read by Form 8995 line 6; businesses other than Schedule C (Schedule E, K-1, farm, passive activities) are refused by scope.schedule1 and scope.passive. Within scope line 3 is the prior year's Form 8995/8995-A line 16 carryforward, entered as a negative. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. For a Schedule D filer the helper is the smaller of Schedule D lines 15 and 16, floored at zero, plus Form 1040 line 3a, as i8995 p. 4, Line 12 says. When Schedule D is not required ('your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040 ... line 7a') the only capital item in scope is capital gain distributions, and the Schedule D lines are still figured from line 13 alone, so lines 15 and 16 both equal the line 7a amount (checked earlier: $1,234 of distributions gives sd.line15 = sd.line16 = f1040.line7a = qbi.net_capital_gain = $1,234). No change to the data.
